meta.name: RPSGT v3 laboratory catalog
meta.routeStatusMeaning: status=v3-ready means the native V3 route, storage, and controller are wired; it does not mean learner-content parity is complete.
meta.contentStatusMeaning: contentStatus separately identifies interactive breadth: interactive-foundation, interactive-rich, interactive-in-progress, review-shell, assessment-tool, or interactive-tool.
meta.copyrightBoundary: Lab descriptions, workflow activities, and learning topics are original Sleep Pathways Guild educational material unless a source is specifically identified.

labs.title: Hookup and Electrode Placement
labs.description: Six guided Study → Apply → Recap stations covering order/equipment review, patient and site preparation, landmark measurement, application and impedance, physiologic calibration, and final signal/documentation checks.

labs.title: EKG Recognition and Response
labs.description: Seven guided Study → Apply → Recap stations using original schematic ECG strips for signal validity, rate and regularity, P–QRS relationship, slow-rate recognition, ectopy, patient-first response, and documentation/handoff, plus a focused 10-question D2B/D3C checkpoint.

labs.title: Visual Recognition and Mini PSG Viewer
labs.description: Interactive PSG-style signal recognition using original schematic tracings, stage choices, feature localization, and a foundation for future annotation and full-night scoring practice.

labs.title: Artifact Recognition and Signal Troubleshooting
labs.description: Original PSG-style visual cases for electrode pop, ECG contamination, slow drift, line-frequency interference, a shared M2 reference disturbance, cross-channel correlation, and next-action decisions.

labs.title: Sleep Staging and Event Scoring
labs.description: Five interactive staging epochs, five respiratory event-evidence cases with ten waveform targets, and eight arousal/limb-movement/artifact/transition-boundary decisions with sixteen supporting clues; multi-epoch scoring remains the next expansion.

labs.title: Respiratory Signals and Event Recognition
labs.description: Restored five-minute full-pattern views for Cheyne–Stokes and periodic breathing, 2:30 click-the-evidence cases, newer airflow/effort comparisons, a seven-case recognition challenge, and a 10-question checkpoint.

labs.title: PAP and Titration
labs.description: Seven guided Study → Apply → Recap stations using original PAP pathway schematics for order/protocol boundaries, device and interface readiness, acclimation, complete-pattern event response, leak troubleshooting, advanced-mode escalation, and documentation/handoff, plus a focused 10-question D4A/D4B/D4C checkpoint.

labs.title: Instrumentation, Filters, and Signal Pathways
labs.description: Seven guided Study → Apply → Recap stations using original signal-pathway schematics for source-to-display tracing, derivations and shared references, polarity, common-mode rejection, sensitivity and calibration, filters, sampling and aliasing, and pattern-based troubleshooting, plus a focused 10-question D2A/D2B/D2C checkpoint.

labs.title: Pediatric and Infant Sleep
labs.description: Seven guided Study → Apply → Recap stations using original pediatric pathway schematics for developmental context, caregiver preparation, sensor acquisition, developmental staging context, respiratory and gas-exchange integration, safety observation, and documentation/handoff, plus a focused 10-question D1A/D1C/D3A/D3B/D4A checkpoint.

labs.title: MSLT and MWT Protocols
labs.description: Seven guided Study → Apply → Recap stations using original protocol schematics for test indication and developmental fit, pretest sleep schedule, medication/substance planning, preceding PSG adequacy, daytime environment, standardized five-nap MSLT acquisition, reporting/validity, and pediatric MWT boundaries, plus a focused 10-question D1A/D2C/D3A checkpoint.

labs.title: Integrated Troubleshooting
labs.description: Seven guided Study → Apply → Recap stations using original troubleshooting schematics for patient-first safety, problem definition, signal-pathway localization, physiology/video/channel correlation, least-disruptive correction and verification, escalation boundaries, and documentation/handoff, plus a focused 10-question D2B/D2C/D3C checkpoint.

labs.title: Mentoring Diagnostic
labs.description: A targeted 24-item intake for calculations, artifact troubleshooting, scoring-derived data verification, and integrated technologist decisions, followed by an individualized mentoring prescription.

labs.title: Math Coach
labs.description: Indices, sleep calculations, timing, units, formula practice, lesson state, notes, and flagged review.
